title: error
description: Daemon -> client error. fatal=true ends the session.

code.description: Machine reason. Known: version_mismatch, bad_hello, bad_type, bus_init, auth, unauthorized, internal, startup_positions, arm_offline, arm_recovered, bus_lost, overtemp, overcurrent, motor_fault, motor_unreadable, motor_recovered. Open-ended so newer daemons can add codes; clients should show `msg` and not switch exhaustively on `code`.

msg.description: Operator-readable detail. For motor_fault: "<motor>: <error names> (0xNN)", e.g. "right_arm_wrist_flex: overload,overheat (0x24)" — the raw hex is authoritative, the names are best-effort.
